description: Competitor price and stock monitor: track product pages on any shop that publishes its price in structured data (schema.org, Open Graph or microdata) and get every price change and stock change by webhook (Slack, Discord, Zapier, Make, n8n) and RSS/JSON feed. Free for 5 products; price lookup API. This tool checks one public page now (robots.txt obeyed) and returns the extracted product data and what changed since the last public check.
